subject: S-waves

claims.text: travel only through solid materials and not liquids
distractors: travel through all states of matter equally
travel only through liquid and gaseous materials
travel exclusively through the Earth's crust

relationships.effect: they completely disappear beyond 105 degrees from an epicenter
relationships.inference: the Earth's outer core is entirely liquid
distractors: the Earth's mantle is highly viscous
the inner core is made of solid iron
the Earth's crust is fragmented into plates

evidenceExcerpt: The shadow zone of S-wave is larger in extent... This proves that the outer core is liquid.

subject: oceanic plates

claims.text: are denser than continental plates and subduct beneath them
distractors: are lighter than continental plates and ride over them
are of equal density, leading to massive fold mountains
never interact with continental plates directly

relationships.cause: the denser oceanic plate subducts into the mantle
relationships.effect: the subducting plate melts and creates rising magma
relationships.inference: continental volcanic arcs are formed parallel to the trench
distractors: mid-ocean ridges are formed actively
massive non-volcanic mountain ranges are formed
deep intra-plate hotspots are generated

evidenceExcerpt: At convergent boundaries where oceanic and continental crust collide, the denser oceanic plate is pushed beneath the lighter continental plate... forming trenches and inland volcanic mountains.

subject: Calderas

claims.text: are the most explosive of all the Earth's volcanoes
distractors: are gentle shield volcanoes characterized by fluid lava
are extinct volcanic remnants that never erupt
are strictly underwater mid-ocean ridge vents

relationships.inference: they collapse inward to form massive depressions rather than tall mountains
distractors: they build the tallest volcanic mountains on Earth
they spread fluid lava to form vast plateaus
they immediately solidify into steep plug domes

evidenceExcerpt: These are the most explosive of the earth’s volcanoes... when they erupt they tend to collapse on themselves rather than building any tall structure. The collapsed depressions are called calderas.

subject: the Himalayan belt

claims.text: is situated entirely at a converging continent-continent boundary
distractors: is situated on a rapidly spreading divergent boundary
is located along a major oceanic transform fault
is an isolated intraplate region far from boundaries

relationships.cause: ongoing collision between the Indian and Eurasian plates
relationships.effect: immense stress accumulates on thrust faults like the MBT and HFF
relationships.inference: the region is highly prone to devastating, shallow high-magnitude earthquakes
distractors: the region experiences widespread active volcanic eruptions
the region is completely seismically stable
the region only experiences deep-focus mantle tremors

evidenceExcerpt: The entire Himalayan belt is situated at the boundary of the converging Indian and Eurasian plates. Thrust faults such as the MBT and HFF accumulate immense stress, placing the region in Seismic Zone V.

subject: ocean currents

claims.text: circulate warm water from the equator toward the poles
distractors: circulate cold water exclusively toward the equator
only flow in deep underwater channels isolated from the surface
are unaffected by the Coriolis effect

relationships.entity1: Western boundary currents (like the Gulf Stream)
relationships.entity2: Eastern boundary currents (like the Canary Current)
relationships.difference: Western boundary currents carry warm equatorial water poleward, whereas Eastern boundary currents carry cold polar water equatorward.
distractors: Western currents carry cold water, while Eastern currents carry warm water.
Western currents are deep ocean flows, while Eastern currents are atmospheric winds.
Both carry warm water, but Western currents only exist in the Pacific.

evidenceExcerpt: Ocean currents act as conveyor belts. Western boundary currents like the Gulf Stream transport warm water from the equator poleward, raising coastal temperatures, while eastern boundary currents bring cold water equatorward.

subject: the Coriolis force

claims.text: deflects moving air to the right in the Northern Hemisphere
distractors: deflects moving air to the left in the Northern Hemisphere
causes air to move strictly in straight lines between poles
is entirely responsible for generating variations in air pressure

relationships.cause: the rotation of the Earth on its axis
relationships.effect: freely moving objects like wind are deflected
relationships.inference: cyclonic systems rotate counterclockwise in the Northern Hemisphere
distractors: cyclonic systems rotate clockwise in the Northern Hemisphere
winds always blow completely parallel to the equator
high-pressure systems completely collapse

evidenceExcerpt: The rotation of the earth about its axis affects the direction of wind... deflecting it to the right in the northern hemisphere. Because of this Coriolis force, cyclones rotate counterclockwise in the north.
